name: pukial
description: Pukial Claude Code skills: a slide-deck pipeline (deckwright), the Flutter toolkit (ship-check, new-app), ASO screenshot production, GitHub Actions CI hygiene (ci-github-actions), fastlane store releases for Flutter apps (store-release), and more as they land.

plugins.name: pukial
plugins.description: Every Pukial skill in one plugin: deckwright (idea -> spec -> HTML drafts on a design system -> PPTX or HTML deck, with a QA loop), ship-check (Flutter architecture gate), new-app (Flutter scaffolder), aso-appstore-screenshots (App Store and Google Play screenshot pipeline), app-pilot (fast mobile QA flows and screenshots with Jev + agent-device), ci-github-actions (CI within the account's Actions minutes, isolated self-hosted runner), and store-release (fastlane Google Play and TestFlight releases with Sentry symbols and a read-only release-check).
